impossible.label: Identify an impossible section
impossible.observed: The upper footprint lies inside the lower contact face; a cut cannot reverse this containment on their shared chord.
impossible.construct: Vary the stack, axes and planes. Give three real cuts; make one option extend its upper chord beyond the supporting chord. Compare joins and witnesses at each option’s own scale.

marked.label: Identify a directed marked cut
marked.observed: The official stacks distinguish an actual section from an outside silhouette.
marked.construct: Place an offset cap, choose a plane through it or just clear of it, and retain all four options across variants. To test the sight arrow use unequal shoulders which visibly reverse.
marked.extension: The marked plane, observer arrow and paired cut are harness additions.
